import smtplib

from platform_config import http_timeout

SMTP_HOST = "smtp.harbourbikes.example"

files.notifications/notifications.py:
"""Email sending for booking confirmations, receipts and reminders; Celery tasks call send_email."""

import os
import smtplib

from platform_config import http_timeout

SMTP_HOST = "smtp.harbourbikes.example"
SMTP_USER = "notifications"


def send_email(message):
    server = smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587, timeout=http_timeout("notifications"))
    server.starttls()
    server.login(SMTP_USER, os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
    server.send_message(message)
    server.quit()

"""Email sending for booking confirmations, receipts and reminders; Celery tasks call send_email."""

import os
import smtplib

from platform_config import http_timeout

SMTP_HOST = "smtp.harbourbikes.example"
SMTP_USER = "notifications"


def send_email(message):
    server = smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587, timeout=http_timeout("notifications"))
    server.starttls()
    server.login(SMTP_USER, os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
    server.send_message(message)
    server.quit()

"""Email sending for booking confirmations, receipts and reminders; Celery tasks call send_email."""

import os
import smtplib

from platform_config import http_timeout

SMTP_HOST = "smtp.harbourbikes.example"
SMTP_USER = "notifications"


def send_email(message):
    server = smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587, timeout=http_timeout("notifications"))
    server.starttls()
    server.login(SMTP_USER, os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
    server.send_message(message)
    server.quit()

"""Email sending for booking confirmations, receipts and reminders; Celery tasks call send_email."""

import os
import smtplib

from platform_config import http_timeout

SMTP_HOST = "smtp.harbourbikes.example"
SMTP_USER = "notifications"


def send_email(message):
    server = smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587, timeout=http_timeout("notifications"))
    server.starttls()
    server.login(SMTP_USER, os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
    server.send_message(message)
    server.quit()

"""Email sending for booking confirmations, receipts and reminders; Celery tasks call send_email."""

import os
import smtplib

from platform_config import http_timeout

SMTP_HOST = "smtp.harbourbikes.example"
SMTP_USER = "notifications"


def send_email(message):
    server = smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587, timeout=http_timeout("notifications"))
    server.starttls()
    server.login(SMTP_USER, os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
    server.send_message(message)
    server.quit()

"""Email sending for booking confirmations, receipts and reminders; Celery tasks call send_email."""

import os
import smtplib

from platform_config import http_timeout

SMTP_HOST = "smtp.harbourbikes.example"
SMTP_USER = "notifications"


def send_email(message):
    server = smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587, timeout=http_timeout("notifications"))
    server.starttls()
    server.login(SMTP_USER, os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
    server.send_message(message)
    server.quit()

import smtplib

import smtplib

from platform_config import http_timeout
